2040.a: Ooedo Onsen Premium Saiki Annex, 70 Yamada, Misasa, Tōhaku District, Tottori 682-0122, Japan
2040.aj: 〒682-0122 鳥取県東伯郡三朝町山田７０ 大江戸温泉物語Premium 斉木別館
2040.ed: Understated rooms in a casual hot spring hotel offering an open-air bathhouse & dining.
2040.edj: 落ち着いた客室の格式ばらない温泉宿。露天風呂とレストランがある。

rv.t: My girlfriend and I visited your onsen a month ago. Such a beautifiul place! All was perfect: the authentic japanese atmosphere, the buffet, the onsen and the kindness of the staff - especially considering we don't speak japanese. And I suppose that foreign guests are quite rare. Greetings from Italy! 🇮🇹🇯🇵
Oldy but goody! Very clean and well maintained hotel. Great breakfast and dinner buffets. Rooms can be cold just like all the other Japanese rooms but the duvet is very warm.

one of the excellent ryokans i have visited in japan. The food was very traditional and stylish. onsen and the amenities were very good. rooms are clean and traditional japanese style with tatami... view is also very nice. inner garden was stunning at night when the lights on... i strongly recommend this hotel for those who want to enjoy the countryside and the old traditional japan. it may be boring to stay more…

2041.a: Ryo ya, 6 Chome-13-2 Tsujido, Fujisawa, Kanagawa 251-0047, Japan
2041.aj: 〒251-0047 神奈川県藤沢市辻堂６丁目１３−２ 漁や
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2041.ed: Down-to-earth restaurant specializing in seafood dishes, plus beer, wine & sake.
2041.edj: 地魚料理が自慢の落ち着いた雰囲気の店。ビール、ワイン、日本酒なども楽しめる。

rv.t: wow, heavenly fish 🐟 Really fresh fish with very delicate and thin cuts. Aji can smell too “fishy” in other places, but here it was lovely. I recomend to try the aji namerō, which it’s like a tataki of aji, and you mix it some some spring onions, ginger, and nori seaweed. The place is quite cozy, the pictures of fish useful, and the service was excellent. ☺️

My mother’s hometown is here and I went there with my husband and my parents as my parents recommended us. The location is pretty local so it might be difficult to get there if you don’t know the area. But I liked how cosy and chill the place is. The restaurant offers freshly caught fish of the day, and there are several menus which you can order only in a particular season. The sashimi platter we had was brilliant…

The food is exceptional and amazing value for money. The sashimi platter and and other sashimi selection was fresh and local. Every dish we had displayed immense care and attention to detail. The tempura conga eel was incredible. There is no English menu but we managed with some basic Japanese. One of the best places we stumbled upon. Truly a highlight.

2042.a: Hydrangea Road, 1 Chome-16-45 Takanawa, Minato City, Tokyo 108-0074, Japan
2042.aj: 〒108-0074 東京都港区高輪１丁目１６−４５ あじさいロード

rv.t: 2026.6.5、訪問。残り1011日。 ちょうど紫陽花がきれいに咲いていて、フェンスの網の間からポコポコ頭を出しているのが可愛かったです。 春には桜並木が美しく、杏の木もあるのが果物の木が何でもあった実家の庭を思い出し、何だか懐かしい気持ちになれる通りです。 私の好きな人と彼の助手である恋人さんも、結婚してお子さんができたら、ご近所だけにこの道をお散歩する日が来るだろうなぁ。その姿を見て彼への未練を断念したいので、あと2年くらいのうちに2人にゴールインしてほしい～。じゃないと、私が先に人生終わってしまうから。
紫陽花の時期では無かったので残念ですがフェンスの内側に植えられているようでした
ひっそりとキレイに咲き誇る色とりどりのあじさい達。丁寧に植え続けた方々に感謝です。6月が楽しめます。

2043.aj: 〒247-0062 神奈川県鎌倉市山ノ内１８９ 明月院
2043.ed: Founded in 1159, this Rinzai Zen temple features a large round window & hydrangeas on the grounds.
2043.edj: 1159 年を起源とする臨済宗禅寺。大きな丸窓と境内のアジサイが印象的。

rv.t: What makes this temple truly special is its breathtaking hydrangea garden. The entire courtyard is blanketed in blooms—mostly in soothing shades of blue, intertwined with crisp white. It felt like stepping into a sea of flowers. Despite the crowds, everyone was simply there to admire the hydrangeas in silence. Visiting in early summer (June) was perfect; the combination of the ancient temple and the vibrant blue…

Very gorgeous during hydrangea season. Went on the 2nd of June, which I thought was too early for the blooms, but was surprisingly met with most of the flowers already blooming. Arrived around 10am and it was already quite crowded, so if you can, go much earlier than that to enjoy the space more leisurely.

Visiting Meigetsu-in in the morning was a really peaceful experience for me. The temple and garden have such a calm, beautiful feel, and it was easy to take everything in without crowds getting in the way. One thing to keep in mind is that tickets are cash only, so it helps to come prepared. I’d definitely go back.

2044.a: Kaisei Hydrangea Village, 23 Yoshidajima, Kaisei, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa 258-0021, Japan
2044.aj: 〒258-0021 神奈川県足柄上郡開成町吉田島２３ 開成あじさいの里
2044.ed: Visitors say this destination features beautiful hydrangeas, including the impressive "ajisai ike" (hydrangea pond), set against a picturesque backdrop of rice paddies and mountains. They also highlight the friendly staff and the variety of local food stalls and events during the festival. Some reviews mention parking can be difficult.
2044.edj: この場所を訪れた人からは、美しいアジサイが楽しめるというクチコミが多くあります。特に、田んぼや山々を背景にした「あじさい池」は印象的で、見事な景観だと評判です。また、スタッフの対応が親切で、お祭り期間中には地元の食べ物の屋台やイベントが充実しているという声もあります。 一方で、駐車場を見つけるのが難しいという意見も聞かれます。

rv.t: Very pretty hydrangea bloom during ajisai festival. Direct bus available from Kaisei station(240 yen one way) during matsuri on weekend. On a clear day, you can see the top of mt.fuji between mountains.
Came during hydrangea festival and it was an amazing experience. It's a family friendly location. The hydrangeas were blooming beautifully in early June.
Great village to visit - very friendly staff and cozy atmosphere. Worthwhile to visit - plan a day trip and explore the area while you're here!

2045.a: Hakusan Park, 5 Chome-31 Hakusan, Bunkyo City, Tokyo 113-0001, Japan
2045.aj: 〒113-0001 東京都文京区白山５丁目３１ 白山公園
2045.ed: Visitors say this park features a wide variety of beautiful, well-maintained hydrangeas, especially during the hydrangea festival. They also highlight the lively atmosphere with various stalls during events.
2045.edj: この公園を訪れた人は、特にあじさい祭りの時期には、美しく手入れの行き届いた多種多様なあじさいが咲いていると評価しています。また、イベント開催時には、さまざまな屋台が出て賑やかな雰囲気が特徴のようです。

rv.t: 6.6.2023 Beautiful place There is a matsuri this month
Beautiful hydrangea festival
Nice park during blooming season.

2046.a: wanna manna – Iidabashi Sakura Terrace, 飯田橋サクラテラス 2F 2 Chome-10-2 Fujimi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 102-0071, Japan
2046.aj: 〒102-0071 東京都千代田区富士見２丁目１０−２ 飯田橋サクラテラス 2F wanna manna 飯田橋サクラテラス店

rv.t: Wanna Manna is a great place to visit for both lunch and dinner. The food is delicious, and they have a really nice selection of drinks. It’s a comfortable place to relax and enjoy a good meal. The restaurant is owned by a Taiwanese Christian, which makes it a meaningful place to support. It’s also a fun spot for fellowship with friends. Overall, it’s a welcoming place with great food and a good atmosphere.

It’s a good place to visit if you are craving for Taiwanese breakfast. I liked the sour soy soup a lot. Unfortunately, my order didn’t arrived for 30 mins after I ordered through their online app, but the one of the girl realized that I am waiting too much and she cooked it immediately. Thanks ;)

I love Taiwanese food so much. There are few things better than an excellent Taiwanese breakfast, especially the pancakes/crepes. These are even better when you’re buying them in Taiwan from a street vendor for a fraction of the price, but glad to have this option here close to where I live.

2047.a: Yokohama Bayside Marina, 5-1 Shiraho, Kanazawa Ward, Yokohama, Kanagawa 236-0007, Japan
2047.aj: 〒236-0007 神奈川県横浜市金沢区白帆５−１ 横浜ベイサイドマリーナ

rv.t: Yokohama Bayside Marina offers stunning views and plenty of yachts, all within walking distance of a nearby outlet mall.
Gentle breeze and good place for visit. Well maintained and tourist friendly area
It’s a real happening place to go. Loved the vibe and view of bay full of beautiful yachts.

2048.a: Tsubame Kitchen, アトレ品川 ４階 2 Chome-18-1 Konan, Minato City, Tokyo 108-0075, Japan
2048.aj: 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南２丁目１８−１ アトレ品川 ４階 つばめKITCHEN アトレ品川店
2048.ed: Diners like this restaurant's juicy and hearty hamburg steaks, especially the signature foil-wrapped hamburg steak with rich demi-glace sauce, and the delicious side of fluffy potatoes. They also highlight the convenient location, making it a great spot for a quick and satisfying meal. Other reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
2048.edj: セントラルキッチンで管理される牛肉や豚肉を使用し、特製のビーフシチューをかけたハンバーグや、自家製ソーセージなどが味わえる。

rv.t: We had dinner at this famous yoshoku restaurant inside Atre Shinagawa, next to the JR Shinagawa Station on first night in Tokyo after back from Kansai area. We ordered their famous Tsubame-style Hamburg Steak with steam rice, and special menu of Demi-glace sauce Omurice plus a glass of cold German Bitburger beer. The dishes are great, and we love both dishes and the beer drink ❤️. Total costs of the…

The place is really nice, with a good variety of dishes and beers. I recommend the goulash beef hamburger, it's the signature of the restaurant.You can choose between bread or rice. I wish the waiter was a little bit fast, but it's ok. The lunch beer is delicious, very smooth.

Tsubame Kitchen is a famous restaurant located at Shinagawa Station. If you're a fan of hamburgers, it might be worth stopping by. During my visit, I opted for their signature dish, the Tsubame-style Hamburg steak. It's a recommended dish prominently displayed on the menu. I was particularly impressed with how juicy and delicious it was, and the whole potato served alongside was a delightful surprise. One thing to…

2049.a: Tempura Tsunahachi, 4 Chome-10-18 Takanawa, Minato City, Tokyo 108-0074, Japan
2049.aj: 〒108-0074 東京都港区高輪４丁目１０−１８ つな八 ウィング高輪店
2049.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh, crispy tempura, especially the prawns, and appreciate the delicious rice and miso soup. They also highlight the friendly, attentive staff, and the calm, comfortable atmosphere. Some reviews mention the service can be unhelpful.
2049.edj: この天ぷら店を利用した人は、新鮮でサクサクとした天ぷら、特に海老を高く評価しています。また、ご飯と味噌汁も美味しいというクチコミが多くあります。親切で気の利くスタッフ、落ち着いていて快適な雰囲気も好評です。 一方で、サービスがあまり良くないという意見も一部見受けられます。

rv.t: A surprise find. Not a tempura person, this place totally changed my perspective. The tempura was crispy outside but meat was still tender inside. Serving is rather generous. Miso soup stands out too. Must eat is their tempura green tea ice cream. Service is prompt and attentive. Totally recommend this place!

Still our favorite restaurant in Tokyo! The tempura were crunchy but still having retain the flavor of the ingredients used. Though our prawns could be cooked a little longer to make it more crunchier. I went here in November, and the prawns were huge, but I guess spring and summer prawns are smaller as they don't need to buffer against the cold. Do get the tempura ice cream too! I recommend vanilla, matcha doesn't…

Food was fresh and tasty. Tempura was served piping hot and the batter had great texture. Staff was very friendly and kind despite my terrible Japanese pronunciation (I’m so sorry) Clean place and nice cozy environment too 🙂

2050.a: Sarabeth’s, アトレ品川 4階 2 Chome-18-1 Konan, Minato City, Tokyo 108-0075, Japan
2050.aj: 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南２丁目１８−１ アトレ品川 4階 サラベス 品川店
2050.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious French toast, fluffy pancakes, and flavorful eggs Benedict, along with hearty salads and soups. They also highlight the stylish, relaxed atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff. Other reviews mention the food can be overpriced.
2050.edj: 絶賛された朝食が有名なニューヨークのレストランのブランチ。カウンター席もあるお洒落な店内で洋食が頂ける。

rv.t: Here’s a natural English version of your review: Last Saturday, I visited this restaurant for brunch for the first time. I had seen many positive reviews online, especially recommendations for their pancakes, so I decided to bring my foreign friend to try it. At the beginning, the staff who served our food were friendly and helpful, and everything was explained clearly. However, when it was time to pay the bill, we…

I went there for brunch. Although it was around 11 a.m.—a little early for lunch—there was already a line outside. I waited about 5–10 minutes to get in and ordered the eggs Benedict and pancakes. The smoky flavor of the meat and the creamy texture of the eggs were perfect, and the pancakes were wonderfully sweet all the way through. I’d definitely love to visit again.
This place has some of the best French toast I've ever had. Super fluffy and light. The bacon could have been crisper, but it still tasted amazing. I would 10/10 go again!

2051.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Kyushu cuisine, including crispy chicken nanban and fresh sashimi, as well as its welcoming atmosphere and attentive staff. Other reviews mention service can be slow and food can be inconsistent.
2051.edj: この居酒屋を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、サクサクのチキン南蛮や新鮮な刺身など、九州料理を中心とした美味しい料理が高く評価されています。また、歓迎してくれるような店の雰囲気や、気の利くスタッフの対応も評判のようです。 一方で、料理の提供が遅いことや、料理の質にばらつきがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Convenient location and nice atmosphere but the service was incredibly slow and I was overcharged. Yen only.

豚マヨキムチ炒め 1100円 チキン南蛮 600円 ・豚マヨキムチ炒め 豚バラ肉ともやしとキムチを炒めたマヨネーズ感は余りない豚マヨキムチ炒め。 目新しさは無く、かなり無難な感じの仕上がりでごくごく普通に美味しいと言った感じでした。 ・チキン南蛮 鶏もも肉の唐揚げに甘酢と自家製タルタルソースをかけたチキン南蛮。 唐揚げは普通に美味しく、きゅうりをアクセントにしたタルタルソースも美味しいのですが、あくまでもこれは鶏の唐揚げ甘酢タルタルソースがけと言うメニューだと思いました。 ・副菜、小鉢、ご飯、お味噌汁 副菜は和風ドレッシングが別添えされた生野菜で細かい配慮が良い感じです。 小鉢はデザートのパイナップルケーキ。 お味噌汁とご飯は可もなく不可もなく。 ・コスパ まずまずのコスパ。 ・サービス 店員さんの愛想は良い。提供時間はやや遅め。 ・ポイント 金沢八景駅近くの定食屋さん。…

金沢八景の亀遊館でひとっ風呂浴び、さっぱりしたところで味助という九州料理のお店へ。 お通しが凝っていてまずビックリ。お通しをこういう掴みに使うお店はだいたい良店なので、その時点で期待大。 店内もオシャレだし、九州料理を始めとしたおつまみが美味しそう。やかんチューハイでお財布を気にせず気持ちよく飲めるのもよい。 新人さん？がいてお店があまり回ってなかったのだけど、店長が客席の状況に気を使いながら適宜フォローしてて流石。 今日は晩ごはん目的だったので、チキン南蛮定食を頂き軽めに終了したけど、他のメニューも面白そうなのでまた行きたい。

2052.aj: 〒236-0003 神奈川県横浜市金沢区幸浦２丁目６ コストコホールセール 金沢シーサイド倉庫店

rv.t: It was easy enough to get to from the station, which made the visit convenient while I was in Kanazawa. As a Costco fan, I was glad to stop by the warehouse and compare it with what I’m used to back home. I also appreciated being able to check in at customer service right after entering, which helped make the visit smooth.

It’s a Costco. It’s a Costco in Japan. Easily accessible from the Seaside Line train, 10 minute walk from train station. Very crowded and the food court is extremely crowded but quick. Besides all the different products you can’t get in the USA the food court has alternatives to the USA food court. You’ll need either a MasterCard, a Costco gift card or cash to pay. No Visa card accepted like in the USA. Worth the…

A very popular discount warehouse in Yokohama. To shop there and enjoy additional benefits, you must either purchase a membership card or be accompanied by someone who already has one. There are four membership plans available, with the most advantageous being the Executive Business Member card, which costs around ¥10,000 and is valid for one year. Inside, products are displayed on large shelves and pallets. You can…

2053.aj: 〒236-0028 神奈川県横浜市金沢区洲崎町６−１ Sand fish食堂
2053.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh and delicious fish dishes, including sashimi, fried fish, and tempura, with generous portions. They also highlight the welcoming atmosphere and the option to bring in fish caught from their fishing boats. Guests mention the staff are kind and provide excellent service.
2053.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、新鮮で美味しい魚料理を高く評価しています。刺身、フライ、天ぷらなど、種類豊富な魚料理はどれもボリューム満点というクチコミが多くあります。また、温かい雰囲気や、釣り船で釣った魚を持ち込んで調理してもらえる点も特徴です。スタッフは親切で、サービスも素晴らしいという声が聞かれます。

rv.t: I had lunch here 3 times so far during my bicycle trips on the weekend. I always eat the fish plate. The food is delicious, the service is kind and the atmosphere is good.

Best tempura I have had in my life. Caught some fish on a fishing charter and brought it to the restaurant. Sashimi, tempura and aji karaage was super amazing. Great atmosphere as well, definitely recommended!
Love this place - food, vibe, service, price… but the let people smoke inside which partially ruined my wonderful experience

2054.aj: 〒769-1108 香川県三豊市詫間町粟島１３１７−２ 漂流郵便局

Fabulous idea first conceived for the Setouchi Triennale: an old post office is now an art installation where people can send letters to friends or relatives that have died or those they no longer know where they are. Tinged with much sorrow but uplifting at the same time because it is such a great idea.
A nice art installation, will go there again once it opens up, right now it is closed because of COVID!

I was amazed by just watching how they were operating behind the counter. I enjoyed the oolong milk tea and sesame milk tea.

Even before 9pm, the shop smells of tea and there are about 10 people waiting for their order! It's very busy. It's very busy every morning, and it's well-known in the neighborhood!

Local beef hot pot restaurant! I must say that the beef was delicious!
Fresh and delicious vegetables and pork. It's with of second visit.

2057.ed: Unassuming restaurant highlighting classic dishes, including rice, noodles & seafood.
2057.edj: 伝統的な担仔麺、ルーロー飯、海鮮料理を味わえるシンプルな店。

rv.t: From my first bite of danzai noodles, I knew this would be one of my most memorable and cherished travel meals. The combination of garlic, black vinegar, peppers, broth, and other flavors was like a symphony to be savored. I didn't know it was the original place or touristy until reading reviews, I just went on the suggestion of my hostel owner and must have been lucky because there wasn't a wait. I also ordered…

We chanced upon this little gem in central Tainan — a restaurant that’s been trading from the same spot for over a century. The food is very Tainan: mild, subtle, yet fresh and full of flavour, with a gentle blend of southern Chinese tradition and a touch of Japanese influence.
